main_text.p: minus Deus Ifrael: Quę precatus es me de Sanherib rege Assur, (audiui.) Hoc est uerbum quod loquutus est Dominus de eo: Spreuit te & subsannauit te uirgo filia Zió: post te mouit caput filia Ierusalem. Quem probris affecisti & blasphemasti? super quę exaltasti uocem (tuam) & eleuasti in altum oculos tuos? super sanctum Ifraelis. Per manum seruorum tuorum exprobrasti Domino, & dixisti: In multitudine curruum meorum ego ascendi altitudinem montium, latera Libani, & succidam proceras cedros eius, & electas abietes eius, & perueniam ad summitatem extremitatis eius, ad sylvam eius campestrem. Ego fodi & bibi aquas, & exiccabo planta uestigiorum meorum cūctos lacus obsidionis. Nūquid nō audisti, quòd à longinquo (tempore) fecerim eam, à diebus antiquis formauerim ipsam? nunc uerò adduxi eam ut sit in desolationem, & (redigantur) in aceruos ruinarum urbes munitę. Quarum habitatores manu abbreuiati sunt, territi & confusi: facti sunt ueluti herba agri & olus reces, aut fœnum tectorum, & uredo culmū segetis præcedes. Sessione tuā, exitū tuū, & introitū tuū ego noui: & quomodo furore agitaris contra mei?

page.notes: Page number printed as "571" (top right, shown as "ʂ7ᵗ" in the scan). Running head "ANNOTATIONES." Catchword "mei" is shown at the foot as "mef" with a long-s-like final letter; transcribed as "mei" with a [?] mark recommended. Passage is Isaiah 37:23–29 as printed in the Vulgate-style text; the printer's wording was copied as seen, including "Quę", "est", "subsannauit". Several words in the scan are faint or cramped at the line ends (e.g. "fœnum", "culmū", "præcedes") and should be checked against the original.
